notes: DeepFlux 8.1 - the agent grabs videos better. New: list_page_videos enumerates every video on a listing page (title, duration, link) so the agent can pick from a studio or search page instead of guessing; dead-segment tolerance completes an HLS capture when the CDN breaks a handful of segments (up to 0.5%) instead of failing the whole download - the finished file notes the skipped segments; the agent no longer asks permission to keep working (it runs autonomously until done, Stop button still interrupts); per-message limits doubled to 80 turns / 100 model calls / 200 tool calls. Existing installs adopt all of this automatically.
